rows.en:
Oh, I forgot!

Hello… It's [HERO4]…
You fooool!
Whoa!? What? Oh, it's Grandpa…

Don't "Oh" me! Where on earth are you right now?

If you left Tokyo three hours ago, you should've gotten here long ago. What are you doing!

Sorry, sorry… You know what they say, "more haste, less speed," right? So, um… you know…

Hello? Hello? The reception seems kinda bad…

Don't lie to me! The nerve… What's this "more haste, less speed"? You forgot, didn't you?

You take after your late mother… Your grades are fine, but you've got a strangely scatterbrained side.

Well, anyway… hurry and get over here! I'm worried about [HERO2]'s body.

Okay, thanks…

But… he seems to be a little better! Right? [HERO2]…!
Ngh…… Ooooooh!?
Uoaaaah… Ooooooh!!
[HERO2]!? Kyaaaah!
Hm, don't tell me…!?

[HERO4]'s grandfather was an authority on cytology, just like her father. He left the institute several years ago…

Since then… he's apparently been running a dojo for ancient martial arts. He also teaches things like horseback riding…

It seems he'd made some progress researching the Vol cells said to be living as parasites in [HERO2].
Vol cells? I've heard the name, but… what exactly are they?

They're a type of archaeal cell. Since they have no nucleus, they're closer to prokaryotic cells like bacteria.

They're said to have been discovered only in the last ten years or so, and they're considered ancient bacteria adapted to Earth's primitive environment, so to speak.

The problem is their parasitic instinct…

Apparently… they're a terrifying new species that parasitizes the eukaryotic cells of higher animals like us, and devours the host until it's completely assimilated.
Then what about [HERO2]? Is he going to get devoured by that stuff!?
I don't know…

[HERO4]! I was worried about [HERO2]… so I came flying out of the house!

From how you sounded on the phone…

Hm!?

This is serious! The infiltration of his brain cells has already begun.

What do you mean!? [HERO2] was controlling the Vol cells with his own will!

Vortex is… exactly like the hero [HERO2] used to draw ever since he was little…!

Calm down, [HERO4]!

Vol cells are… archaeal cells that parasitize eukaryotic cells!

Until they've completely taken over the host's body, they actively divide again and again and multiply! And when that… reaches the brain cells, [HERO2] will…

[HERO2] is going to be taken over by the Vol cells?

Is it too late to save [HERO2]!? Grandpa…!

It's already beyond my power…

Before it came to this, regular doses of the inhibitor I formulated should have been able to suppress the activation of the adhesion factors…

In any case, [HERO4]… at least you should take the inhibitor…
Just me? You're telling me to save only myself!?
[HERO4]! You're all I have left! Please understand!

…………

I'm sorry… Grandpa… But that's one thing… that's one thing I just can't do!
Hey, [HERO4]! Where are you going? [HERO4]!!
…This sea hasn't changed, has it? Not since back when I played here with [HERO2]…

What's changed… the ones who've changed are us…

Fighting… hurting people… We never even thought about things like that back then…!
Don't leave me behind, [HERO2]!! I… I…
Huh, this feeling… It can't be!? Big brother? You really are alive!?
Oh? What a familiar face…?
Isn't that Satoru's little sister?
Kaori, and even Mr. Todo…

Still… I'm surprised you made it out of that big fire alive. I was sure you'd been caught up in it too.

From the look of it… you haven't even awakened yet, have you?
Awakened…?

Means you haven't "evolved" like us.

I thought I'd burned all you failures to ashes, but…
Burned… What do you mean? Don't tell me it was you, Mr. Todo…!?

That's right. On Satoru's orders…

Though the one who set the first fire was your old man, Dr. Hinata… And he took Kaori's old man down with him!

My brother's orders…? Papa set the fire?

What are you talking about? I don't understand at all… Liar! That's a lie, a total lie!
Please… Tell me it's a lie, big brother!

Satoru… The "scent of the beast" we've been chasing… it seems to be somewhere near here, doesn't it?

I'll avenge Papa!
…!? The scent of the beast…?
Oh, looks like you know something. What shall we do, Satoru?
Make her talk…
Huh…?
Slow as ever, huh? He means we'll ask your body directly! Where the scent of the beast is!
Grooooooh!!
Mr. Todo, that form…!?

Volhazard! This is Tatsuya's EATER… It's finally awakened! He's a bit of a late bloomer!

Tatsuya! Make sure you make her talk before you kill her!
Yeah… I know, I know!

…!?

What's that sound?
My phone…?
Damn it… I missed the kill! What an irritating sound…
[HERO2]!? Are you all right?

This scent…

It seems he's the one. Test Subject 004! We've finally found you!
I can feel it too… The powerful scent of the beast! So we've found what we were looking for, huh?

…!?

The infiltration has reached his brain cells.

Vol Textured Type, Vortex! His EATER is the type that adapts to its environment and situation and keeps reconstructing its cell tissue…

For Satoru's Volfeed, which fuses with and absorbs other beings, he's the finest prey there is!
What are you going to do to [HERO2]!?

I was gonna devour him myself… but Satoru says he wants to devour him!

Satoru's EATER has a bigger appetite than mine!

Heh heh… Someone who hasn't even awakened isn't worth eating! I've got no more use for you! You failure!
Kyaaaah…!?
[HERO2] is just standing there… We can eat him easily!
Heh heh heh…

No… At this rate, [HERO2] will…!

Please… Vol inside me! Lend me your strength, now of all times!

I don't care what happens to my body… So, one more time… that "power" that awakened that day, in those flames…!!

…!?

You… had awakened too? And without even letting us sense it…

You really are Satoru's sister. Your EATER… Velvet… probably has some special power too…?
Who cares. It just means there's one more piece of prey!
I won't let you do that!
Mr. Hongo… Why are you here?

On the day I became a cyborg… you two saved my heart. Now it's my turn to save you!

Now, [HERO2]! Stay back.
That's Kamen Rider? Tatsuya, be careful! I can't read his power at all.
Hmph… Cautious as ever, huh?
Your Volhazard won't go down easily, I'm sure… but if things get dangerous, pull back!

Yeah, yeah. Go on, get out of here!

…Now, let's get started!
Ugh…
[HERO4]… So that child has finally awakened too!?
Sei… jiro…

[HERO2]!? You've come to?

I see… The inhibitor I injected just for peace of mind… No, that can't be all there is to it, can it? You two never stop surprising me…
…Seijiro! Is that [HERO4]? It's [HERO4], isn't it!?
That's right… You'll save her, won't you? [HERO2]?
[HERO2]…!?
[HERO2]…!?

uncertain: U02269/U02324: 轟機鋼剤 (a serum Seijiro formulated to suppress Vol) rendered 'the inhibitor'; 轟機鋼 is the Lucifard-route armor name and looks like a mis-decoded glyph group here (cf. 轟合 = 融合 in U02305)
U02252: 急がば回れ rendered 'more haste, less speed'
U02260: Dr. Hinata (her father) used as 'her father'
U02286: カオリの親父さん = Assistant Minoshima (B0003)
U02316: [HERO2]君 in Hongo's line, but context suggests he may be speaking to [HERO4] (Velvet); kept the tag as written
U02323/U02325: 清次郎さん rendered 'Seijiro' (-san dropped)
